Class NetpbmHeaderTokenizer

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.inputOutput.InputStreamTokenizer
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.inputOutput.FileHeaderTokenizer
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.inputOutput.NetpbmHeaderTokenizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Tokenizer
public class NetpbmHeaderTokenizer extends FileHeaderTokenizer
Concrete tokenizer for Netpbm file headers.

Implements Tokenizer.skipToTheToken() to handle the two categories of non-token content defined by the Netpbm specification:

  • Whitespace – any sequence of spaces, tabs, carriage returns and newlines is skipped silently.
  • Comment lines – a # character introduces a comment that extends to the end of the same line ('\n'). The entire comment is discarded.

All three non-magic tokens (736, 1197, 255) are returned correctly even though a comment line appears between the magic word and the dimensions.

Author:
Dmitro Dashchenko

    • skipToTheToken

      public int skipToTheToken() throws EOFException, IOException
      Description copied from interface: Tokenizer
      Advances the stream past any leading whitespace and comment lines

      Implementations must ensure that the returned byte is then used by Tokenizer.readToken() as the first character of the token being assembled, so no data is lost.

      Returns:
      the first significant (non-whitespace, non-comment) byte, as an unsigned integer in the range 0–255
      Throws:
      EOFException - if the stream ends before a token start is found
      IOException - if any other I/O error occurs
